claims.text: ATS 2025: 3–4 days for nonsevere CAP (outpt or inpt) if clinically stable w close follow-up;
claims.quote: The 2025 guideline update from the ATS recommends a shorter duration (3 to 4 days) for outpatients or inpatients with nonsevere community-acquired pneumonia, provided they reach clinical stability and have close follow-up (3).
In all other circumstances, a minimum of 5 days is still recommended.
